title: Use a model-neutral communication layer
supabiz_proposal: Wrap Relaycast/SDK behind a SupaBiz transport interface. Swap model or harness without changing job identity, message contracts or business records. Do not make coding-agent terminal injection the default executor for restaurant transactions.
measure: Model/adapter swap success; protocol compatibility failures.

title: Create a room for a job, not an endless swarm chat
supabiz_proposal: One room follows a supplier quote, inventory transfer or accountant request. Show participating businesses, accountable person, requested result, deadline and evidence. Keep technical agent messages expandable.
measure: Time to understand status; unresolved jobs; unnecessary notifications.

title: Bind agents to a business principal
supabiz_proposal: Use immutable agent and business IDs plus credential versions. A human-readable name is a label, not authority. Separate Consu, ForeFathers and supplier workspaces even when Varun owns two of them.
measure: Wrong-business disclosure and action tests; credential rotation recovery.

title: Separate delivery receipts from work receipts
supabiz_proposal: Retain transport accepted/delivered/deferred/failed separately from job accepted/in_progress/needs_approval/result_submitted/verified. A supplier agent receiving a PO does not confirm its commercial acceptance.
measure: False completion rate; time in each state; unowned accepted work.

title: Expose small typed capabilities
supabiz_proposal: Define request_quote, share_approved_availability and submit_reconciliation_result with schemas. Validate input, then current server-side permission and constraints before execution. Validate output and independently verify external effects.
measure: Schema rejection quality; unauthorized handler invocations; invalid results after effects.

title: Exchange minimum evidence, not whole memory
supabiz_proposal: Share a purpose-specific summary and authorized document references with scoped access and provenance. Do not copy all chat history into a partner context. Apply permission checks to search and dereferencing, including derived summaries.
measure: Unnecessary fields disclosed; expired evidence access; retrieval permission failures.

title: Make relationship grants explicit
supabiz_proposal: A relationship grant binds issuer, recipient business/agent, allowed capabilities and data, purpose, limits, expiry and delegation depth. Check at request acceptance, evidence access and action commit. Transport credentials never replace it.
measure: Revoked or expired grant attempts blocked; cross-tenant negative tests.

title: Use invitations with a reviewable access preview
supabiz_proposal: Let a manager invite a named accountant or supplier to one job or bounded relationship. Show identity, scope, expiry and changes before joining; include disconnect/revoke. Unsolicited requests remain in an inbox until accepted.
measure: Onboarding completion; mistaken invitations; time to revoke.

title: Keep durable business idempotency above event dedupe
supabiz_proposal: Use a persistent business action key, payload hash, atomic claim and remote reconciliation. Same-source duplicates, reconnects and retries days later must not create duplicate purchase orders. Conflicting payloads for the same key require rejection.
measure: Duplicate effects; ambiguous outcomes reconciled; conflicting retries blocked.

title: Verify delegation proofs against trusted issuers
supabiz_proposal: Resolve issuer trust independently of the message; validate signature, audience, expiry, capability and current revocation. A proof cannot broaden the parent grant. Keep received text and tool instructions untrusted.
measure: Forged, replayed or wrongly scoped proof rejection; grant-chain limits.

title: Recover work without skipping earlier messages
supabiz_proposal: Persist per-job progress and independent message acknowledgment. An out-of-order ack must not erase older work. Use deadlines, lease renewal, backoff, dead-letter handling and an owner for stuck jobs.
measure: Recovery after restart; missing messages; dead-letter age.

title: Give people a collaboration console
supabiz_proposal: Show requested, shared, approved, committed and verified events as a compact timeline. Provide exact-action approval, pause, revoke, reassign and disputed-result paths. Label whether a button stops future work or requires compensating an existing effect.
measure: Time to resolve an exception; accidental approvals; status comprehension.

title: Bound delegation and agent conversation
supabiz_proposal: Cap depth, participants, tool calls, spend, duration and message rate per job. Track parent job and causation IDs to detect loops. Prefer direct task routing; broadcast only to an authorized bounded audience.
measure: Cost per verified job; loops; fan-out; budget-stop correctness.

title: Treat deployment topology as an adoption gate
supabiz_proposal: Pilot self-hosted Relaycast in a limited environment. Before production, validate version compatibility, durable recovery, isolation, backup/restore and connection limits; choose managed service or redesign shared state for replicas.
measure: Restart data-loss tests; restore time; queue lag; peak-connection limits.

title: Make privacy and connection changes visible
supabiz_proposal: Present capture/sharing/telemetry settings and credential destinations separately. Track who connected which device and business. Explain temporary inbound permissions and how they expire or are restored.
measure: Unexpected scope changes; stale device credentials; configuration restoration.

title: Turn each boundary failure into a regression case
supabiz_proposal: Add empty-list denial, cross-business leakage, stale approvals, changed quotes and duplicate commits to the harness. Preserve Asakana’s scoped correction → approved rule → regression test loop. Never promote a policy based only on a successful happy path.
measure: Regression coverage; false authorization; verified outcome rate and cost.
